questions.prompt: Name a club Samuel Eto'o played for

traps.name: Arsenal
traps.why: Eto'o scored against Arsenal in the 2006 Champions League final but never played for them.
traps.why_es: Eto'o les marcó al Arsenal en la final de la Champions de 2006, pero nunca jugó en él.

traps.name: AC Milan
traps.why: He won the treble with Inter in 2010, not with their neighbours: he never played for Milan.
traps.why_es: Ganó el triplete con el Inter en 2010; nunca jugó en el Milan.

traps.name: Paris Saint-Germain
traps.why: A name linked to him over the years, but he never signed for PSG.
traps.why_es: Su nombre sonó mucho, pero nunca fichó por el PSG.
